default.heading_text_1: 1. Intellectual Property Ownership of Zarincode Products
default.description_1_body: All proprietary WordPress themes (including the Zarincode Elementor-Based Theme), WordPress plugins, custom Elementor widgets, UI kits, and ready-made software source codes published on Zarincode.com are original works authored by Ehsan NaderiPanah. Unauthorized redistribution, nulled/cracked distribution, scraping, reverse engineering, or resale without an official commercial license from Zarincode.com is strictly prohibited and subject to immediate DMCA takedown notices sent to hosting providers, Cloudflare, Google Search, and GitHub.

If you believe in good faith that any material, code snippet, graphic asset, or content hosted on or linked through Zarincode.com infringes your copyright, please send a written DMCA Takedown Notice containing all of the following statutory elements (pursuant to 17 U.S.C. § 512(c)(3)):
default.list_item_text_1: A physical or electronic signature of the copyright owner or a person authorized to act on behalf of the owner of an exclusive right that is allegedly infringed.
default.list_item_text_2: Identification of the copyrighted work claimed to have been infringed (or a representative list if multiple works are covered by a single notification).
default.list_item_text_3: Identification of the material that is claimed to be infringing and exact URLs on
default.list_item_text_4: reasonably sufficient to permit us to locate the material.
default.list_item_text_5: Your full legal name, mailing address, telephone number, and valid email address.
default.list_item_text_6: A statement that you have a good-faith belief that use of the material in the manner complained of is not authorized by the copyright owner, its agent, or the law.
default.list_item_text_7: A statement that the information in the notification is accurate, and
default.list_item_text_8: , that you are authorized to act on behalf of the owner of an exclusive right that is allegedly infringed.

default.description_1_body: If your material was removed or disabled as a result of a DMCA notice and you believe such removal was the result of mistake or misidentification, you may submit a written Counter-Notification to our Designated Copyright Agent including:
default.list_item_text_2: Identification of the material that has been removed and the location at which the material appeared before it was removed;
default.list_item_text_3: A statement under penalty of perjury that you have a good-faith belief that the material was removed or disabled as a result of mistake or misidentification;
default.list_item_text_4: Your name, address, telephone number, and a statement consenting to the jurisdiction of the competent court.
